```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

## Specified True Parameters

This report reflects a *specified* configuration of true effects and is intended as a study-planning summary, not an empirical result.

```{r}
p <- params$dgm_params
knitr::kable(data.frame(
  Parameter = c("Mean X", "Var X", "Reliability X",
                "Mean Z", "Var Z", "Reliability Z",
                "Cov(X,Z)", "b0", "b1", "b2", "b3", "True R2"),
  Value = c(p$mean_x, p$var_x, p$rel_x,
            p$mean_z, p$var_z, p$rel_z,
            p$cov_xz, p$b0, p$b1, p$b2, p$b3, p$R2_true)
))
```

## Population-Level Coefficients

```{r}
knitr::kable(params$coef_table, digits = 3)
```
